RKC Waalwijk is a Dutch professional football club based in Waalwijk, North Brabant. The club competes in the Eerste Divisie, the second tier of the Dutch football league system. Its name is an abbreviation of Rooms Katholieke Combinatie, reflecting its origins as a merger of three local Catholic clubs in 1940.
